title: Trend Micro Apex One Improper Access Control Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Trend Micro Apex One. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the web console. The issue results from improper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information from the application.
